protocols.title: N-Acetyl Semax Amidate intranasal reference schedule
protocols.purpose: Source-reported intranasal research schedule; not independently validated clinical guidance
protocols.population: Research reference; the source notes limited amidate-specific clinical research
protocols.evidenceNotes: Peptides.org's chart and dosing section describe an intranasal research reference starting at 600 mcg/day, with adjustment as needed and a maximum of 900 mcg/day for up to 30 days. The chart indicates 2–3 pumps/day. It also lists an alternative of 600 mcg/day for up to 60 days. The page says amidate-specific clinical research is lacking and draws on Semax references.

schedule.description: Source says start at 600 mcg/day and adjust as needed, up to 900 mcg/day; chart expresses this as 2–3 pumps/day. Spray strengths listed are 10 mg/10 mL (0.1%) and 30 mg/10 mL (0.3%), each said to deliver 300 mcg per dose.

regimen.notes: The source describes cycling off for a duration equal to the study duration. Its alternative schedule is recorded separately. This is a source-reported research reference, not an established clinical protocol for N-Acetyl Semax Amidate.

protocols.title: N-Acetyl Semax Amidate intranasal extended reference
protocols.population: Research reference; amidate-specific clinical validation not established
protocols.evidenceNotes: Peptides.org lists this as an alternative research schedule. Amidate-specific clinical administration data are described by the page as lacking; source claims are not independently validated.

schedule.description: 600 mcg daily for up to 60 days, as listed as an alternative by the source.

regimen.notes: Source lists up to 60 days at 600 mcg daily, followed by a washout period equal to study duration. This is not a validated human protocol.

protocols.title: N-Acetyl Semax Amidate injectable reference
protocols.population: Research reference; source does not specify injection route
protocols.evidenceNotes: Peptides.org lists this as an alternative research schedule. Amidate-specific clinical administration data are described by the page as lacking; source claims are not independently validated.

schedule.description: Source says start at 500 mcg once daily and increase to 1,000 mcg once or twice daily. It does not state when or how to increase.

regimen.notes: Injectable route is not specified. The page lists this as research reference, with a maximum study duration of 30 days and washout equal to study duration. Do not infer a route or titration schedule.

protocols.title: N-Acetyl Semax Amidate injectable extended reference
protocols.population: Research reference; source does not specify injection route
protocols.evidenceNotes: Peptides.org lists this as an alternative research schedule. Amidate-specific clinical administration data are described by the page as lacking; source claims are not independently validated.

schedule.description: 600 mcg daily for up to 60 days, as listed in the source's alternative-regime row; route is not specified there.

regimen.notes: The source's alternative-regime row lists this for injectable formulations as well. Route and administration details are not provided. Washout is equal to the study duration.
